nodes.statement: A fixed positive spectral exclusion survives strong convergence of the negative-point resolvents on an identified comparison Hilbert space.
YM-T-010 plus YM-T-030 do not currently instantiate the application hypotheses of R001.
No admitted evidence supplies a cutoff-indexed physically normalized self-adjoint generator family with cross-regulator state-space comparison.
The YM-T-030 correlation-decay mass gap is not currently a full Hamiltonian spectral exclusion for the transfer-generator spectrum.
No admitted theorem supplies a scale-set cutoff trajectory from the YM-T-030 strong-coupling domain to the intended continuum theory.
Construct or locate a cutoff-indexed physical generator family and cross-regulator comparison maps.
Prove one cutoff- and volume-uniform positive spectral exclusion in the physical normalization.
Prove convergence of the identified physically rescaled resolvents to the target limiting Hamiltonian.
Combine an actual physical generator family, a uniform physical spectral exclusion, valid state-space comparison, R001 spectral stability, continuum convergence, and any required zero-sector control.

cross_debt_dependencies.effect: If the physical generator is obtained through Osterwalder-Schrader reconstruction, the limiting Schwinger hierarchy and reconstruction hypotheses must be supplied there.
The cutoff-indexed family must lie on an actually controlled four-dimensional continuum trajectory; D001 cannot manufacture that continuum construction.
Turning source-level correlation decay into the bottom of the full non-vacuum Hamiltonian spectrum requires the separate observable-completeness/converse-spectral interface.

false_proof_firewalls: Spatial covariance decay in lattice distance is not automatically a spectral gap of the full transfer generator.
Unit lattice spacing cannot be converted into a cutoff-uniform physical gap by dimensional analysis alone.
Infinite volume at fixed regulator is not the ultraviolet continuum limit.
A fixed-regulator transfer matrix plus a separate fixed-regulator correlation estimate does not define a continuum-indexed generator family.
Absence of a proved strong-coupling-to-continuum trajectory is not a proof that no such mathematical bridge can ever exist.
current_frontier: After R002, the smallest material D001 target is the missing regulator-to-generator interface. Search for or construct a cutoff-indexed physically normalized generator family with explicit state-space comparison before attempting another uniform-gap or convergence claim.
certification_boundary: No node in this DAG is a MATHCERT certificate. R002 is a Solve candidate source-interface falsification; YM-D001 and YM-001 remain open.
